verses.1: And God spoke all these things.
verses.2: I, Jehovah your God, have brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery.
verses.3: There will be no other gods before me.
verses.4: Do not make for yourself any idols or any images that are in the heavens above, or those that are on the earth below, or those that are in the waters beneath the earth.
verses.5: Do not worship them, and do not serve them. For I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God who will punish the sins of parents against their children, against all those who are hated by me.
verses.6: And he shows mercy to thousands of my lovers and to those who keep my commandments.
verses.7: Do not carry the name of Jehovah your God as an idol. For Jehovah will not forgive those who carry His name as an idol.
verses.8: Remember the day of Shabbat as a day of holiness.
verses.9: For six days, you shall work, and do all your tasks.
verses.10: And on the seventh day, during Shabbat, you shall not do any work. You and your children, your servants, your animals, and your crops that are in your fields, you must not work at all.
verses.11: For in six days, Jehovah created the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that is in them. On the seventh day, He rested. Therefore, Jehovah blessed the day of rest, and made it holy.
verses.12: To honor your father and your mother, so that your days may be long on the earth that Jehovah your God gives you.
verses.16: Do not be deceived by your friends’ lies.
verses.17: Do not eat the house of your enemy. Do not eat his wife, his servants, his animals, and everything else that belongs to your enemy.
verses.18: And all the people saw the sounds and the flames, as well as the sound of the trumpets. They also saw the mountain being covered in smoke. The people stood up from their places and faced away from it.
verses.19: And they said to Moses, “Your words shall be with us. Let them be heard. But let God not speak to us, otherwise we will die.”
verses.20: And Moses said to the people, “Do not be afraid. For in order to test you, God has brought this upon you. But because of His love for you, He will not let you sin.”
verses.21: And the people stood far away, while Moses rushed towards the cloud where the God was.
verses.22: And the LORD said to Moses, “Say to the children of Israel, ‘You have seen that I spoke to you from heaven.’”
verses.23: Do not make me your god of silver or gold. Do not worship those gods.
verses.24: I will make it a sacrifice to Adama. You have sacrificed your offerings and sacrifices upon it. You have also offered your gifts and offerings in every place where I will mention my name. I will come to you and bless you.
verses.25: And if you make idols out of stones, then they will not be able to stand firm. For your destruction will bring them down upon them, and they will be destroyed.
verses.26: And you shall not place anything on top of my altar, so that your evilness may not be revealed there.
